name: HH breakout 01 — squeeze-expansion directional long (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: volatility clustering is the one robustly-documented crypto property (GARCH persistence beta ~0.7-0.9, clusters lasting weeks), so a low-realized-vol / narrow-bandwidth coil genuinely FORECASTS a vol expansion. The other side is options/vol-sellers and grid market-making bots who systematically short gamma into quiet ranges; when the coil breaks they must cover/hedge into the move, feeding the expansion — we are long realized-vol convexity they are short. Gate on bb_width in a multi-day LOW percentile (bbw below a fitted floor) AND vol_realized compressed (below a fitted floor), then enter ONLY on a full-bar close pushing range_position to the UP extreme (>0.95, fitted) with adx confirming the break has trend behind it. bar_size 1h so the coil is measured over days and the break has room to pay real fees. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if, conditioning on the low-bb_width coil, the post-break realized return distribution is symmetric and its mean is within one fee-round-trip of zero net of fees (expansion happens but no directional/magnitude edge to harvest) — or if PBO/CSCV shows the bb_width percentile threshold is the only thing carrying it (curve-fit on the squeeze cutoff).
catalyst: compressed volatility coil breaks UP with trend confirmation
